title: eriosema spicatum subsp. collinum
intro: Eriosema spicatum subsp. collinum, commonly known as Collin's Eriosema, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Collin's Eriosema include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Eriosema spicatum subsp. collinum for medicinal purposes.
